- Signer: Alex Moran (VP Finance). Procurement contact is procurement@clearriver.com.

Sylvia / Jordan — thanks for the context. I’ll own the initial redline but want to set expectations and capture a few required items to avoid churn: 

High-level approach (first pass):
- Use Redwood Standard MSA v3 (we’ll highlight deviations in track changes).
- Key commercial/legal flags we expect to address: liability cap tied to fees, security/data residency clause (explicit US-only residency + encryption at rest), IP carve-outs for customer data, limited audit rights, and SLA remedies scoped to dedicated capacity.
- For order form: we’ll populate quantity/term/pricing and include a migration/data deletion section.

Items we need from ClearRiver to proceed with a clean first draft:
1) Full legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the signature block (including LLC/Inc).
2) Billing address, EIN/tax id (US entities), and a PO number if you have one.
3) Signatory authority: confirm Alex Moran (title and email) and whether finance or legal will countersign.
4) SOC 2 report or attestation URL — if not available, please tell us the expected delivery date.

Turnaround & process: assuming we receive the party sheet + PO today, we’ll aim to post a redline within 48 business hours. If there are novel enterprise terms (data processing addendum, custom indemnities), that may add one additional business day.

Attached: MSA_v3_markup-guidelines.docx (internal guidance), signature-authority-template.csv — fill and return if helpful.

I’ll also propose a short 30-min kickoff on Mon 12 Oct to align on technical constraints and signature path. Jordan — can you propose a time?

Thanks,
David Kim
